title: Stable softmax and cross-entropy, with gradients
hints: exp(z) overflows for z > ~709. Softmax is invariant to subtracting a constant per row, so subtract the row max first.
log(softmax(z)) = z - logsumexp(z). Compute it directly instead of taking the log of a probability that may have underflowed to 0.
For one-hot targets, d(loss)/d(logits) = (softmax(z) - onehot) / N when the loss is the mean over N rows.
